headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, with AI emerging as a key driver.
summary: Most major players reported double‑digit revenue growth YoY. TCS delivered a 15.4% rise and a 24% operating margin. HCLTech and LTM highlighted AI‑related sales, while Wipro saw modest margin pressure. Several firms (Infosys, OFSS, Persistent) have not yet released full results, adding uncertainty.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: AI revenue contributions are rising across TCS, HCLTech, LTM and Wipro, supporting top‑line expansion.
